text: Start Ready (Bangladesh) is a country-level deployment of Start Network’s disaster risk financing mechanism aimed at protecting vulnerable communities from floods and tropical cyclones. It utilizes pooled funds, probabilistic risk analysis, and reinsurance-backed rapid financing to enable anticipatory and early action, as well as immediate post-shock response. The initiative is supported by the Swiss Re Foundation and operates alongside Start Network’s broader mechanisms in Bangladesh.
